Noch keine. Zum Beispiel den Namen deine: None yet. For example the name of your servers, “prod” or a regex for ticket numbers.

Gesperrt. UwUSSH fragt nach dem Master-P: Locked. UwUSSH asks for the master password as soon as something in it is needed.
Entsperrt. Gespeicherte Passwörter und K: Unlocked. Saved passwords and keys can be used.
Passwörter und Keys liegen verschlüsselt: Passwords and keys are stored encrypted in the vault, with Argon2id and XChaCha20-Poly1305. The master password never leaves this device.
Bis zum nächsten Start. Offene Verbindun: Until the next start. Open connections stay open.
Offene Verbindungen bleiben bestehen; ne: Open connections stay open; new ones ask for the master password again.
Noch keine Keys. Erzeuge einen mit UwUKe: No keys yet. Generate one with UwUKeygen or import a key file (OpenSSH, PEM or PuTTY).
Name: Name
Ohne Passphrase liegt der private Key un: Without a passphrase, the private key is stored unencrypted in the file.
Alle Hosts mit Bereichen, Gruppen und Ho: All hosts with workspaces, groups and host keys in one .uwussh file – with passwords and keys if you like, then encrypted with a password of its own.
Aus einer .uwussh-Datei, aus Termius, Pu: From a .uwussh file, Termius, PuTTY, KiTTY or ~/.ssh/config. Hosts you already have are skipped.
Beta bekommt neue Versionen früher. Es k: Beta gets new versions sooner. Things may wobble now and then.
UwUSSH lädt neue Versionen still herunte: UwUSSH quietly downloads new versions and installs them on the next start. Every update is signed and checked before it starts.
Freie Software unter der GNU GPL v3.0. N: Free software under the GNU GPL v3.0. Use it, change it, share it – only changed versions have to stay open. No tracking, no account.
Misst in einem eigenen Tab, wie schnell: Measures in a tab of its own how fast the terminal processes output (milestone M0).
Normalerweise öffnet UwUSSH keine Verbin: Normally UwUSSH opens no connection by itself. Here you can choose a local shell or particular hosts instead.
Keiner gewählt – dann öffnet beim Start: None chosen – then nothing opens on start.
{system} öffnet den Tresor beim Start fü: {system} opens the vault on start for your user account, without the master password. Other accounts and other computers still need it.
Das ist kein gültiger Code. Kopiere ihn: That isn't a valid code. It's best to copy it in full.
Mit einem eigenen UwUSSH-Server bleiben: With a UwUSSH server of your own, hosts, groups, keys and passwords stay the same on all your devices. The server only ever sees encrypted blobs.
Das erste Gerät: mit dem Einrichtungscod: The first device: with the setup code the server shows when it first starts.
Ein weiteres Gerät: mit dem Code, den ei: Another device: with the code a device that's already connected shows under “Add a device”.
Einen Server aufsetzen: siehe github.com: Setting up a server: see github.com/MinifyX/UwUSSH-Server – one command, Docker, done.
Steht im Log des Servers, oder: docker c: It's in the server's log, or run: docker compose exec uwussh uwussh-server invite. It holds the address, the certificate fingerprint and an invite.
Mindestens 8 Zeichen. Es verlässt dieses: At least 8 characters. It never leaves this device.
Deine Hosts und Keys kommen mit – nichts: Your hosts and keys come along – nothing is encrypted again.
Verbunden ✧ Jetzt das Recovery-Kit siche: Connected ✧ Now keep the recovery kit safe
Dein Tresor braucht ab jetzt das Master-: From now on your vault needs the master password and this code. Your devices remember the code – but if all devices and the code are gone, the data is gone. UwUSSH shows it only this once.
Ich habe den Code sicher aufgeschrieben: I've written the code down somewhere safe
Auf Papier oder im Passwort-Manager – ni: On paper or in a password manager – not only on this computer.

Das Passwort, mit dem das erste Gerät de: The password the first device connected the server with. Hosts already on this device come along.
